artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan adding a shared gitignored-specs predicate library, a V13 classification gate with two new non-failure exit codes (8/9) in git-commit-scoped.sh, consumer exit-code handling, and the per-operation contract for both postures in git-staging-scope.md.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan adds a new classification gate to a long-lived shell script that already has an extensive test suite, the suite itself is a first-class edit surface the research phase routinely misses: an existing case may assert exactly the behaviour the new gate reclassifies. In git-commit-scoped.sh's suite, case U5 asserted exit 2 plus 'genuinely unstaged' for an untracked ignore-matched pathspec -- precisely the shape a new ignore-aware gate turns into a non-failure outcome. The authoring rule that falls out: before planning any new classification gate, grep the covering suite for the old outcome's own assertion strings, and schedule the gate and the suite amendment as one atomic-batch phase so the phase cannot close red. Separately, in this repository a new scripts/lib/*.sh plus scripts/tests/test-*.sh pair requires three registration surfaces that produce no authoring-time signal when missed: manifest.json's provides.scripts (repaired by sync-manifest-scripts.sh --write; a missing entry means the script is never deployed), tests/suite-classification.data (a unit/integration row, enforced by lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh), and index-entries.json's line_count for any edited indexed context file.
